devices.description: List of block device paths (e.g., /dev/sda) presenting SCSI emulation connected to the Tableau bridge. Corresponds to the 'device' argument.

remove_dco.description: If true, directs tableau-parm to permanently remove a DCO (Defined Capacity Option) if it exists. Corresponds to the '-r' flag.

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose logging/diagnostics for device identification and bridge interaction.
